text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her primary goal, the Classic Triple Crown 
route, finally gets underway with its 
first leg, the Satsuki Shoâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Oooooohh!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh!!
choice_data_list: (Her voice is louder than the cheers!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! It's Epiphaneia...!" "Good luck!" "We 
believe in you!" "Go take the Triple 
Crown!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Aaaaagh!! Thank you, everyone!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you in the baseball cap! I can really 
feel your passionate cheering!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And you with that wonderful smile!! You 
came with my acrylic keychain, didn't you? 
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You must be... a fan of Logo! Cheer your 
heart out for her! But don't you dare take 
your eyes off me, either!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "Ooooooooohh! Go get 'em, Epiiiiii!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her long-awaited main event right 
before her eyes, her excitement surged 
even higher—far too high, in fact.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm heading out!! To the race!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Then I'll start it!! On your mark!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I tried every countermeasure I could, 
but in the end, her fighting spirit kept 
overflowing, and I couldn't keep it under 
control.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what Logo is up to!? Going over 
to play would be... a bad idea, right!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I can't wait to race her!! I hope 
Logo feels the same way!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Logo is definitely going to show us an 
amazing run!! The entire audience was 
expecting nothing less!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Logotype, who won the Asahi Hai FS and 
became the Junior-tier champion. It's only 
natural that expectations are high for her 
after such a commanding victory on the big 
stage.
choice_data_list:
(Still, if Epi can just bring out her full 
potential...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has plenty of power, capable of 
powering through any elevation changes 
without a problem. If she can just control 
herself... she'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, you're worried, aren't you? 
About whether I can actually run properly.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there's no problem at all! 
Sure, the hand pushing my back has been 
burning hot, but—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's only 2000 meters! I just have to 
burst through the finish line before my 
legs give out!!
choice_data_list:
...Yeah, let's believe in our own 
strength.

...Yeah, let's believe in our own 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course I know that! I'm bringing 
home that first crown, just you watch!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Logotypeee!!" "Do your best!" "We're 
counting on you!"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
...If I live up to their expectations now. 
It will surely pave the way, opening up 
the future—

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"With these legs, I will protect what is 
precious to me!"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, shall we get to it~?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Woah, she's... super focused. Somehow... 
I can't look away—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Logo!! Finally—we meet at this stage!!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Epi-san...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I remembered just how strong you are!! 
I've been waiting for this all 
along—running with you!!"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I've been waiting for 
this myself.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
If I beat you today. Under this 
overwhelming spotlight... if I properly 
give everything I've built up—

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Our paths will connect. That's what I 
believe.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right! The Voice of Destiny 
says so too! Everyone's gonna want to know 
more about you— just like me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Still, I feel the same way. Winning amidst 
this overwhelming attention—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So that my light reaches everywhere! I 
will connect my own destiny!!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Still, Epi-san. I feel like the Satsuki 
Sho... today is my only chance.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I will not lose. I will never 
yield."

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: I... —I will defeat you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"That's it, I can't take it anymore!! 
Logo, let's duel!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Even your fiery passion! Will be swallowed 
whole by the sun!!
